facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.justification: MOC-2011-0025 was raised at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop on 22 February 2011 following 2 recorded events in the archive, including AF-2017-001 and NM-2010-0015. The change request record covers 2 clauses across 3 controlled documents. The intent is to strengthen the critical safeguard named in the documents in scope. The record reached the state abandoned in the change stream.
response.risk_note: No control is relaxed by this change; the residual risk position is unchanged or improved, and the critical safeguard set is preserved.
response.scope_note: The documents in scope are MOC-2021-0155, PRO-MIN-003 and STD-MEQ-007.
